armL.note: left shoulder: the arm reaches and draws back with the steps, the dynamite in its hand with it

armR.note: right shoulder: the other way round

head.note: centre of the body: sways with the steps

bundle.note: the dynamite strapped to the head: follows the head and jiggles a little on its own

face.note: the highlight, the outline and the eyes: exactly the head, drawn over the bundle
